When using this app, we do not collect, process, or share any personal data with third parties.

The movable objects on the playing field must be moved so that the mouse can collect everything, without being caught by the cat.

🐁 The mouse: collects cheese and water

🐈 The cat: collects fish and milk, is afraid of the dog and the raccoon

🐕 The dog: collects bones, is afraid of the raccoon

🦝 The raccoon: collects eggs
